summary: Lock the account after repeated failed sign-in attempts
description: As a Contoso Pay customer, I want my account to be locked after several failed sign-in attempts so that nobody can guess my password.
acceptanceCriteria: After 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts, the account is locked for 15 minutes.
While locked, sign-in is refused even with the correct password, and the message says when the customer can try again.
A successful sign-in resets the failed-attempt counter.
The customer receives an email alert when the account is locked.

summary: Reset a forgotten password by email
description: As a customer who forgot my password, I want to reset it with a link sent to my email so that I can get back into my account.
acceptanceCriteria: The reset link is sent only to the email address registered on the account.
The reset link expires after 30 minutes and can be used only once.
The new password must be at least 12 characters and include a number and a symbol.
The new password cannot be the same as any of the last 3 passwords.
All other active sessions are signed out after a successful reset.

summary: Verify sign-in with a one-time SMS code
description: As a customer, I want to confirm new sign-ins with a code sent to my phone so that my account is protected even if my password leaks.
acceptanceCriteria: A 6-digit code is sent by SMS when the customer signs in on a new device.
The code is valid for 5 minutes.
After 3 wrong codes, a new code must be requested.
The customer can request a new code at most once every 60 seconds.

description: As a verified customer, I want to send money to another Contoso Pay user so that I can pay friends instantly.
acceptanceCriteria: The minimum transfer amount is $1.00.
A verified customer can send up to $2,500 per day in total.
If the balance is lower than the amount, the transfer is blocked with an 'Insufficient balance' message.
The customer sees a confirmation screen with the recipient's name and amount before sending.
Both sender and recipient get a notification when the transfer completes.

summary: Add a bank account as a withdrawal destination
description: As a customer, I want to add my bank account so that I can withdraw my balance to it.
acceptanceCriteria: Account holder name, routing number and account number are required.
The routing number must be exactly 9 digits.
The account number must be between 8 and 12 digits.
The account cannot be used for withdrawals until two micro-deposits are confirmed.
A customer can save at most 3 bank accounts.

summary: Show the instant withdrawal fee before confirming
description: As a customer, I want to see the instant withdrawal fee before I confirm so that there are no surprises.
acceptanceCriteria: The instant withdrawal fee is 1.5% of the amount, with a minimum of $0.25 and a maximum of $15.00.
The fee and the amount the customer will receive are shown before confirming.
Standard withdrawals (1 to 3 business days) are free and offered as an alternative.
Amounts are rounded to the nearest cent.

description: As a customer, I want to filter my transaction history and export it so that I can do my budgeting and taxes.
acceptanceCriteria: The customer can filter by date range, transaction type and amount range.
The date range cannot be longer than 12 months.
The filtered results can be exported as a CSV file.
If no transactions match, a 'No transactions found' message is shown and export is disabled.

summary: Freeze and unfreeze my card from the app
description: As a customer who misplaced my card, I want to freeze it from the app so that nobody can use it while I look for it.
acceptanceCriteria: The customer can freeze the card from the card screen with one tap and a confirmation.
While frozen, card payments and ATM withdrawals are declined.
Recurring payments already set up continue unless the customer chooses to block them too.
Unfreezing requires the customer to confirm with their PIN or biometrics.
The card status shown in the app updates within 5 seconds.

description: As a customer, I want to choose how I get notified so that I only receive what matters to me.
acceptanceCriteria: The customer can switch push and email notifications on or off separately for payments, marketing and account activity.
Security alerts (new device sign-in, password change) cannot be switched off.
Changes are saved immediately and apply to the next notification.
Marketing notifications are off by default for new customers.

summary: Change the email address on my profile
description: As a customer, I want to update my email address so that I keep receiving receipts and alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: The new email address must be verified with a link before it replaces the old one.
The verification link expires after 24 hours.
A notice is sent to the old email address when the change is requested.
An email address already used by another account is rejected.

description: As a customer, I want to split a payment with friends so that everyone pays their share.
acceptanceCriteria: A bill can be split between 2 and 10 people, including the customer.
The bill can be split equally or by custom amounts.
With custom amounts, the shares must add up exactly to the bill total before the request can be sent.
With an equal split, any leftover cent is added to the customer's own share.
Each person receives a payment request they can accept or decline.

description: As a customer, I want the app to sign me out when I leave it idle so that nobody can use my account on an unattended device.
acceptanceCriteria: The session ends after 10 minutes without activity.
A warning with a 'Stay signed in' button appears after 9 minutes.
Tapping 'Stay signed in' restarts the 10-minute timer.
Any unsaved transfer form is discarded when the session ends.

description: As a customer, I want to dispute a card transaction I don't recognise so that I can get my money back.
acceptanceCriteria: Only card transactions from the last 60 days can be disputed.
The customer must choose a reason and can attach up to 3 files of at most 5 MB each.
A transaction can only be disputed once.
The customer gets a case number and sees the dispute status as Open, Under review, Resolved or Rejected.

summary: Make the payment screen accessible to screen-reader users
description: As a customer who uses a screen reader, I want the payment screen to be fully accessible so that I can send money on my own.
acceptanceCriteria: Every input field and button has an accessible name read aloud by VoiceOver and TalkBack.
Validation errors are announced when they appear and are linked to the field they belong to.
All actions can be completed with a keyboard or switch control, in a logical focus order.
Text and controls meet a colour contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

summary: Display amounts in the customer's currency format
description: As a customer, I want amounts shown in a format I understand so that I don't misread a payment.
acceptanceCriteria: Amounts always show 2 decimal places.
The currency symbol and thousands separator follow the customer's region setting (for example $1,234.56 in the US).
Negative amounts (money going out) are shown with a minus sign and in red.
Amounts of $1,000,000 or more are displayed in full, never abbreviated.

summary: Reward customers who refer a friend
description: As a customer, I want to earn a bonus when I refer a friend so that I'm rewarded for spreading the word.
acceptanceCriteria: Each customer has one personal referral code.
The referrer and the friend each get a $10 bonus after the friend's first transfer of at least $20.
A customer cannot use their own referral code.
A customer can earn at most 10 referral bonuses per calendar year.
